items.title: TherapistTrack
items.description: SaaS platform for psychologists, streamlining the management of notes and appointments with an intuitive and secure interface.
items.longDescription:
TherapistTrack is a complete web platform specifically designed for a mental health clinic. The system allows appointment management, creation of session notes with customizable templates, and secure encrypted records of all patient information.

The project emerged from the need to digitize processes that were traditionally handled on paper, providing a modern, secure, and easy-to-use solution that complies with all medical data privacy regulations.

details.challenge: The psychologist needed a secure and efficient way to digitize patient management workflows, while preserving privacy and complying with healthcare regulations.
details.solution: We developed a SaaS platform with robust authentication, end-to-end encryption, and an intuitive interface that minimizes the learning curve and is mobile-adapted.

items.title: FindCareerAI
items.description: Web platform that uses AI to analyze skills, interests, and labor trends, providing personalized recommendations
items.longDescription:
FindCareerAI is an innovative platform that combines artificial intelligence with university curriculum data analysis to help incoming students make informed decisions about their careers.

Using advanced AI models and vector databases, the system can analyze user profiles, compare them with thousands of successful career paths, and provide personalized recommendations with a high level of accuracy.

details.challenge: Students needed personalized guidance based on real local university data, not just generic personality and vocational tests.
details.solution: We implemented an AI system that combines semantic skill analysis with real-world data, using vector embeddings to find precise matches.

items.title: Feedback Finder
items.description: Mobile application that allows users to leave and consult reviews of restaurants, shops, and local services, with a user-centered design.
items.longDescription:
Feedback Finder is a mobile application designed to revolutionize how users discover and share experiences about local businesses. The project focused mainly on building an intuitive and accessible user experience.

The design prioritizes ease of use, with intuitive flows for leaving reviews, exploring nearby places, and discovering new options based on personal preferences.

details.challenge: Existing review apps were complex and overloaded with information, making the experience difficult for casual users.
details.solution: We designed a minimalist interface with emphasis on visual experience and ease of navigation, validated through multiple rounds of testing with real users.

items.title: TheCozyWhiskers
items.description: Web platform for order management, inventory, and customer service in coffee shops.
items.longDescription:
TheCozyWhiskers is an integral management platform for coffee shops that unifies the order system, inventory control, and customer service in a single modern web application.

The system allows baristas to take orders quickly, manage stock in real-time, and offer an exceptional customer experience through order status notifications and an integrated loyalty system.

details.challenge: Coffee shops needed a unified system to replace multiple disconnected tools for orders, inventory, and payments.
details.solution: We developed a responsive web platform with scalable architecture, real-time synchronization, and high availability to support peak hours.

items.title: TimerApp
items.description: iOS timer application with notifications and real-time synchronization
items.longDescription:
Timer App is an iOS mobile app designed to improve productivity through time management techniques such as Pomodoro. The app includes smart notifications and personalization.

The project focused on creating a smooth and efficient native experience, focusing on simplicity and practicality.

details.challenge: Users needed a simple but powerful time management tool that integrated natively with iOS without compromising battery performance.
details.solution: We developed a native Swift app with battery optimizations, smart local notifications, and widgets for quick access.
